---
title: "Glucose Meter vs. Lab Analyzer"
author: "JRW"
date: "2026-10-31"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.align = 'center', out.width = '80%')
options(width = 90)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
Glucose <- read.csv("Glucose_Meter.csv")
```

```{r}
sapply(Glucose[, c("Meter", "Lab")], function(x) {
  c(n      = length(x),
    mean   = round(mean(x), 2),
    sd     = round(sd(x), 2),
    median = round(median(x), 2),
    min    = min(x),
    max    = max(x),
    se     = round(sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)), 2))
})
```

```{r}
t.test(Glucose$Meter, Glucose$Lab,
       alternative = "two.sided",
       mu = 0,
       conf.level = 0.95,
       paired = TRUE)
```
